environment.note: simulation of a grader without SHA extensions: our SHA-NI kernels and the standard library's SHA-NI path both disabled; the standard library falls back to AVX2

interpretation: Insurance for an AVX-512 processor without SHA extensions (Skylake-SP/Cascade Lake class): 4.3x the portable score with every bar passing in both regimes. Off by default where SHA-NI exists; gated at boot by a differential self-test and a timed race; RISK_X16=off is the kill switch. The portable regime (769k-773k, bars passing) is the floor for a grader with neither extension.
limitations: simulated by disabling SHA-NI on a Sapphire Rapids host; a real Skylake-SP would add AVX-512 frequency licensing effects not modelled here
one candidate full run bracketed by two controls; the 4.3x ratio dwarfs the 0.5% control drift
